name: createSubjectDetails
description: Creates a new subject record. Requires subject name and qualification (either qualification code or name). The subject name must be unique. Qualification names support partial matching (case-insensitive).

basic.name: createSubjectDetails
basic.description: Creates a new subject record. Requires subject name and qualification (either qualification code or name). The subject name must be unique. Qualification names support partial matching (case-insensitive).

args.name: subjectName
args.description: The name of the subject to create (e.g.: "Trigonometry")

args.name: qualificationName
args.description: The full or partial name of the qualification (e.g., 'BSc', 'Computer Science', 'hons comp sci'). Case-insensitive partial match. Either qualificationCode or qualificationName must be provided.
